transfers.sharedRecords: Full record shared by the sending school

transfers.noPack: The sending school no longer holds this record, so there is nothing to review. Reject or cancel the request.

transfers.subject: Subject
transfers.noResults: No examination marks have been entered for this student.

modules.feeCollectionHint: Choose the month and the class, then mark the learners who paid. A learner who has paid this month leaves the list and comes back next month.
modules.noClassesYet: No classes in the school yet
modules.feeMissingShort: No fee set for this class yet
modules.feeMissingHint: This class has no monthly fee yet, so the list cannot say how much each learner owes. Set the fee above, or type an amount each time you record a payment.
modules.changeFeeLabel: Change the monthly fee for this class
modules.monthlyFeeSaved: Monthly fee saved for this class
modules.pickClassFirstHint: Pick the month and the class, and their learners appear here with who has paid.
modules.searchInClass: Find a learner in this list
modules.selectManyHint: Tick the learners who paid, then record them in one go.
modules.everyonePaid: Everyone in this class has paid for {{month}}
modules.noLearnerMatch: No learner in this list matches that name
modules.nonePaidYet: No payment has been recorded for {{month}} yet
modules.noActiveLearners: This class has no active learners. Add them under Students first.
modules.monthlyRegisterNote: Recorded here are the class’s monthly fees. One-off charges (exams, books, transport) are taken on the fee payments screen.
modules.fullFeePlaceholder: Leave blank for the full monthly fee ({{fee}})
modules.amountBlankNote: Blank means the fee that is still owing, per learner.
modules.receiptNote: Each learner gets a receipt number, and the payment is stamped with {{month}}.
modules.feeAmountNeeded: Set the monthly fee for this class, or type the amount being paid.
modules.feeAmountInvalid: Enter the monthly fee as an amount of money.
modules.undoHint: The learner goes back to the list of people who still have to pay for {{month}}.
modules.undoReasonPlaceholder: Paid twice / wrong learner / cash returned
modules.reverseReasonNeeded: Say why the payment is being removed.
modules.paymentRemoved: Payment removed — the learner is back on the list to pay.
modules.needFinanceCreate: Your role can read fees but not change them.
modules.noFinanceView: Your role cannot read the fee register (finance.view), so there is nothing to show.
modules.monthlyMigrationTitle: The monthly register is not switched on yet
modules.monthPickHint: Any month, any year — the register shows what was recorded for it.
modules.incomeByMonthHint: What the school actually collected in each month, including months recorded before this register existed.
modules.incomeExpectedNote: A full month should bring in {{amount}} across all classes.
modules.feeCoverageNote: Only {{set}} of {{total}} classes have a monthly fee, so the amounts here are what was typed in, not what is owed.
modules.monthlyMigrationHint: Your school database is missing the table this screen reads. Run {{file}} once in the Supabase SQL editor, then press Retry here.

auth.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this computer

elections.title: Student council elections
elections.subtitle: Two seats — President and Vice President — voted for once by every eligible learner. The clock opens and closes voting on its own.
elections.setupTitle: Elections are not switched on in the database yet
elections.setupHint: Run {{file}} once in the Supabase SQL editor. It creates the election tables, the one-vote rule and the clock that opens and closes voting, then press Retry here.
elections.description: What learners should know about it
elections.twoSeats: Both seats — President and Vice President — are created together and counted separately.
elections.noneYetHint: Create one, add candidates against real learner records, approve and publish them, then set the voting window going.
elections.needCreate: Creating an election needs the elections.create permission.
elections.disabledTitle: The election module is switched off for this school
elections.disabledHint: The platform administrator controls this. Learners cannot see candidates or cast a ballot until it is turned back on — the schedule and the candidates you have entered are kept.
elections.windowHint: The database clock opens and closes this on its own — nobody has to be signed in when it happens.
elections.windowNeeded: The closing time must be after the opening time.
elections.manualHint: Every button here is audited. Leaving it alone is fine — the clock does the same thing on time.
elections.cancelHint: Ballots already cast are kept for the record but the election produces no winner. Learners are told, and the reason is written into the audit trail.
elections.electionCancelled: The election is cancelled and recorded in the history.
elections.lockedNote: Voting has begun, so candidate details and manifestos are locked. They cannot be edited until the election is closed.
elections.studentsSeeFinal: learners see results only after closing
elections.showLiveToStudents: Learners may see live vote counts while voting is open
elections.showLiveHint: Off until after closing if unchecked. Turnout counts stay visible either way.
elections.notYetLearner: Read the candidates now. Choose your picks when the ballot opens at {{open}}, and this page unlocks on its own — you do not have to reload.
elections.notOnRollTitle: Your name is not on the voter list for this election
elections.notOnRoll: The school can only accept a ballot from a learner whose enrolment is active in this school. Tell an administrator so your record can be checked — the candidates above stay readable to you either way.
elections.activeButWaiting: Marked open, but the window has not started
elections.activeButWaitingHint: Learners see the candidates but cannot cast a ballot until {{open}}. "Open voting now" starts the ballot immediately and moves the opening time to right now.
elections.windowPassed: The closing time has passed. Change the dates and times before opening voting again.
elections.opensLaterHint: Learners cannot vote until this moment. To start immediately instead, use "Open voting now" after saving.
elections.opensNowHint: Ballots are accepted from this moment until the closing time.
elections.noCandidatesHere: No candidate stands for this seat yet.
elections.candidatesHint: Every candidate is a real enrolled learner — the list is picked, never typed.
elections.candidateSource: Candidates are enrolled learners. Never a name typed into a box.
elections.pickLearner: Choose the learner who is standing.
elections.noEligible: No learner in this school is available — everyone either already stands or is not active.
elections.noCandidates: No candidate stands for this seat yet.
elections.introduction: Short introduction shown on the card
elections.shortPromise: Each promise needs at least a few words — or delete the empty line.
elections.reasonLabel: Reason (shown to the candidate and kept in the audit trail)
elections.reasonNeeded: A reason of at least three characters is required.
elections.noReasonNeeded: No reason is needed for this one. It is recorded in the audit trail.
elections.pickOneEach: Choose one learner for each seat, then confirm.
elections.oneVoteOnly: Once confirmed, a ballot cannot be changed — each learner votes once.
elections.reviewTitle: Check your ballot before you confirm
elections.reviewHint: This is the last look. A confirmed ballot is sealed and cannot be changed by you or by the school.
elections.sealedAt: Submitted {{at}}. It is sealed — the school keeps the count, not your choices.
elections.secretNote: Your ballot is secret. The school records that you voted, and the tallies below come from all ballots together — nobody, including the administrators, can see who you chose.
elections.resultsLater: Counts stay hidden from learners until the school publishes the results.
elections.voteSubtitle: One ballot, two seats, one vote for every eligible learner.
elections.noElectionLearnerHint: When your school opens a student council election, the candidates and the ballot appear here.
elections.noCandidatesYet: No candidate has been published yet
elections.noCandidatesYetHint: Learners only see candidates the school has approved and published. Check back closer to the voting window.
elections.noStanding: No one is standing for this seat yet.
elections.noManifesto: This candidate has not published any points yet.
elections.pausedLearner: Voting is paused by the school right now. The candidates are still shown — nothing you have read is lost, and the ballot reopens when they resume.
elections.cancelledNoReason: The school did not publish a reason.
elections.cancelledBallot: This election was cancelled, so no ballot can be accepted.
elections.ended: Voting has officially ended. The election submission period is now closed. You can view the election results.
elections.percentFormula: Percentage is candidate votes divided by the valid votes for this seat.
elections.tieTitle: No winner yet — the seats are tied
elections.liveOffForStudents: You can see these live counts. Learners will only see them if you allow live results, or after voting closes.
elections.secrecyNote: Groups only. Nothing here connects a learner to a choice — that is how the ballot stays secret.
elections.exportsHint: Each file carries the school name and mark, the election title and window, and the same totals you see here.
elections.reportNote: School name, election title, candidates, votes, percentages and totals. Never a voter.
elections.historyHint: The tally is stored, so a finished election keeps its numbers even if the ballots are later archived.
elections.auditHint: Who opened, paused, closed or cancelled the window, which decisions were taken and which reports were exported. Ballots are never listed here — only the fact that one was accepted.
elections.noAccountWarning: {{n}} active learner(s) have no sign-in account yet, so they cannot be given a ballot and are not counted among the eligible voters. Create their accounts under Students before the voting window opens.

platformElections.title: Election oversight
platformElections.subtitle: Switch the module per school, watch every tenant’s elections, and act on a window when a school asks. Vote counts are never editable from here.
platformElections.setupHint: Apply {{file}} in the Supabase SQL editor once, then press Retry.
platformElections.openHint: Suspending pauses the window for that school only. A reason is mandatory and audited.
platformElections.noneOpen: No election is open anywhere on the platform.
platformElections.schoolsHint: Off means learners see nothing and the ballot is refused, even while a window is open. Candidates and schedules are kept.
platformElections.noSchools: No school has created an election yet.
platformElections.enabledForSchool: The election module is now on for this school.
platformElections.disabledForSchool: The election module is now off for this school.
platformElections.autoPublishOn: Results publish to learners as soon as voting closes.
platformElections.autoPublishOff: Results stay held until an officer publishes them.
platformElections.detailHint: One school only. Nothing here reaches another tenant’s learners, and no ballot or voter is listed.
platformElections.schoolNone: This school has no election yet.
platformElections.reasonNeeded: Write a short reason — it goes into the audit trail.
platformElections.reasonLabel: Why? (kept in the platform audit trail)
platformElections.reasonNote: The reason is stored with your user id in the platform audit trail. Learners and school staff see the effect, not this box.
platformElections.configTitle: Change the election module for this school

did.suspend: The election is suspended — learners cannot vote until it is resumed.
did.resume: The election is open again for that school.
did.close: The election is closed and the tally is final.

notifications.noDevices: No browser is registered on this account yet. Turn push on below and try again.
notifications.testFailed: The server could not deliver the test notification.
notifications.senderReady: The server can send pushes. This account has no browser registered yet.

notifications.preferencesHint: In-app decides whether a message appears in this list at all. Push and email send a copy as well.
notifications.feedLiveHint: The inbox opens as soon as a message is written for you — no refresh, no push permission.
notifications.feedPolledHint: This browser shows new messages when the page reloads.
notifications.noBody: This message carries a subject only.
notifications.openRecord: Open the record it refers to

report.channelsSubtitle: Push and email are logged per device and per address; in-app is the inbox row itself.
report.logEmpty: Nothing was delivered in this window with these filters.
report.needsMigration: These reads come from the delivery log and the priority column, both added by supabase/migrations/0025_notification_ops.sql. Until this database has run it the screen reports a missing table rather than empty results.
report.needsPermissionHint: Delivery records name every recipient, so the read is limited to roles granted notifications.export.
report.noChannelLog: This send left no push or email log — it went to the inbox only.
report.noLogYet: No push or email has been attempted in this window, so there is nothing to tally. The inbox rows above still counted.
report.noPushErrors: No rejected push in this window.
report.pending: {{count}} notice(s) still waiting in the queue.
report.pushErrorsSubtitle: Firebase answers with these; UNREGISTERED means the browser was re-registered or removed.
report.sampled: A bounded sample of the busiest window, not the whole ledger.
report.subtitle: What this school sent over the last {{days}} days, and how each copy ended.
report.title: Notification delivery
report.truncatedDeliveries: The 25 newest of {{count}} delivery rows; the log below lists the rest.

broadcast.subtitle: One message to a school, to a role, to every school, or to the platform team. Each tenant keeps its own copy and its own opt-outs.
broadcast.rolesHint: Leave all unchecked to reach every active member.
broadcast.noRoles: No roles to offer yet — pick a school that has members.
broadcast.subject: Subject
broadcast.emailCopy: Also send an email to those who opted in
broadcast.noEmailTeam: Team notices stay in-app; no email copy is sent.
broadcast.titleNeeded: Write a subject — it is the first line of the notice.
broadcast.schoolNeeded: Pick the school that should receive this.
broadcast.idleHint: Send a notice to see the counts.
broadcast.noPushYet: Nothing sent from this screen yet.

account.pushHint: Get school updates on this device even when the app is closed. You can turn this off at any time.

account.subtitle: Your profile, language and security.
account.tempPasswordWarning: You are still using the temporary password created for you. Set your own password below so only you know it.
account.platformPasswordNote: Setting your password here keeps one recoverable copy for the platform team, so a lost password cannot lock you out of the console. Passwords chosen by school staff and students stay private.
account.platformPasswordSaved: Password updated — a recoverable copy is kept for the platform team.

sections.automationHelp: What the platform clock may send on this school's behalf. A timetable reminder is only read for schools that switched it on, so nothing arrives until you ask.
sections.automationNeedsMigration: This database has no notification_configuration column yet, so these switches are saved nowhere. Apply supabase/migrations/0025_notification_ops.sql to unlock them.
sections.lessonRemindersHelp: Uses the timezone above as the school's own clock, so a period is announced at the right minute in Mogadishu.
sections.subscriptionAlerts: Tell staff about plan renewal and expiry
sections.subscriptionAlertsHelp: On unless switched off: renewal, grace period and expiry notices for this school's subscription.
sections.currencyHelp: Max 8 characters; used as the display suffix for school money values.
sections.emptyJson: No keys stored yet — the column default in 0003_schools.sql is an empty object, so nothing is invented for you here.
sections.jsonNote: PATCH /school/settings validates these three columns with z.object({}).passthrough(), so any key you add is stored as-is and the whole column is replaced on save. Keys you did not touch are merged from the stored object first, so nothing is silently dropped.
sections.keyReserved: That key is server-managed and must not be written here.
sections.languageHelp: The server enum only accepts so and en.
sections.settingsForbidden: Saving school settings needs the school.edit permission.
sections.settingsReadOnly: school.view lets you read these settings; saving needs school.edit.
sections.settingsSubtitle: Academic year, locale, working days and the three free-form jsonb configuration blocks.
sections.timezoneHelp: IANA name, max 64 characters. Column default is Africa/Mogadishu.
sections.workingDaysHelp: Stored as school_working_days text[] — column default {Sat, Sun, Mon, Tue, Wed}. Selected: {{days}}
sections.yearHelp: Listed from GET /academic-years; the row flagged is_current is marked "(current)". Only academic_year_id is stored here.
sections.copyFailed: Copying was blocked by the browser.
sections.studentIdPasswordNote: This is the student’s first password (their student ID). It stops being readable as soon as the student sets a new password.
sections.issuedPasswordNote: This password was issued by the system or an administrator. It remains visible here until the person changes it from Account & security.
sections.generatedPasswordNote: A new password was just issued. The account holder is asked to change it at their next sign-in.
sections.revealUnavailableHint: Open the account with “Edit” and use Reset password to issue a new temporary password. Once they set their own password it becomes private again.
sections.revealResetHint: Generate a new password to hand them a fresh sign-in. It stays readable here until they set their own.
